translations.web: They gave them drinks in golden vessels of various kinds, including royal wine in abundance, according to the bounty of the king.
translations.bsb: Beverages were served in an array of goblets of gold, each with a different design, and the royal wine flowed freely, according to the king’s bounty.
translations.kjv: And they gave them drink in vessels of gold, (the vessels being diverse one from another,) and royal wine in abundance, according to the state of the king.
translations.asv: And they gave them drink in vessels of gold (the vessels being diverse one from another), and royal wine in abundance, according to the bounty of the king.
